races.paceDynamic: Reciprocated appears the sole committed front-runner in this small field, with most others showing prominent tendencies but no obvious early speed merchants. The modest pace pressure should allow Reciprocated to dictate terms without being harried early, creating a sustainable gallop through the first half of this 6f sprint. With Cape Ashizuri, Alaminos, Anaisa and Awraad likely settling just behind the leader, the race sets up as a tactical affair where positioning at halfway becomes crucial. This moderate early pace strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can track the leader and quicken, rather than hold-up horses like Daydreama who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Reciprocated Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Reciprocated gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm without serious pressure until 2f out
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate fractions and kick clear when the challengers come, with any fellow front-runner getting first run at the pace-setter. Prominent racers with tactical speed get the ideal trip tracking the honest pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Cape Ashizuri, Alaminos or Anaisa press Reciprocated early and create more pace pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and favour those with natural speed who can travel strongly in the leading group. Hold-up horses get a better pace to aim at but may find the leaders have gone clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling through 4f, turning into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Daydreama benefits most from the slow tempo as his hold-up style comes into play with a furious final 2f dash. The early leaders may stop quickly after such a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Reciprocated simultaneously at the 3f pole creating a bunched field finish
scenarios.body: The even pace means stamina and class become the decisive factors rather than tactics. Any horse with a turn of foot can win from various positions.

watchPoints.text: Reciprocated must be monitored for fitness after 214-day absence, as any sluggish start ruins the pace scenario
Cape Ashizuri and Alaminos both returning from long breaks could be rusty early and disrupt their prominent tactics
Daydreama needs tracking for market support as hold-up horses rarely win these tactical Pontefract sprints
Weather changes affecting the going as several runners have limited form on good ground
Jockey tactics if the pace becomes crawling, particularly whether Reciprocated's pilot maintains or quickens the gallop

races.paceDynamic: Antrim, Romieu, and Sunriseontheboyne will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three natural front-runners likely to contest the early lead. This creates a fast, testing pace over 1m2f that will set up the race for the hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick. The prominent runners like Insanity and Fireblade may find themselves caught between the pace battle and the closers. This pace shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can stay off the early speed and deliver late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go forward and create a fierce early gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final furlong, setting up perfectly for the hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks to sweep past the leaders. Flying Frontier, Marhaba Ghaiyyath, and Savvy Victory are ideally positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Pacemaker Gets Loose
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners breaks clear while the others fight behind
scenarios.body: A lone leader could steal a march and prove hard to peg back, especially if the chasers don't organize effectively. Antrim or Romieu could capitalize if they escape the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders settle into a more measured rhythm early
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical, allowing prominent runners to travel well and kick clear of both the spent leaders and trapped hold-up horses. Insanity and Fireblade can position perfectly behind a steady pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners hesitate or get into a speed duel that kills their chances completely
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with leaders stopping and closers having too much ground to make up, creating chaos in the finish. Any horse getting a smooth trip benefits.

watchPoints.text: Monitor if all three natural leaders Antrim, Romieu and Sunriseontheboyne commit to making the running from the start
Check the betting moves on Flying Frontier who returns after a long break but has winning course form
Watch for Savvy Victory to be produced with a late run having shown he retains ability in Listed company

Note whether the prominent runners Insanity and Fireblade can secure the ideal tracking positions behind the leaders

races.paceDynamic: Yorkshire Glory and No Return will set a sustainable early pace, with Yorkshire Glory likely to make all after nine straight wins including his last Newcastle success. The modest pace will keep the field bunched, allowing hold-up horses like Newsreader, Great, Hectic, and Azure Zain to stay in touch throughout. This moderate gallop will create a sprint finish from the 2f pole where tactical positioning becomes crucial. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick, as they avoid traffic problems while the hold-up brigade fights for racing room in a congested finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Yorkshire Glory dominates again
scenarios.trigger: If Yorkshire Glory gets his preferred uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: His nine-win streak continues as he dictates terms from the front, with the field struggling to peg him back despite his career-high mark. Prominent racers tracking him get first run but can't match his momentum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses surge late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes a war of attrition where class and fitness tell, allowing horses like Great and Newsreader to use their turn of foot. Azure Zain and Hectic benefit from the strong pace but need clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Yorkshire Glory goes off too fast trying to kill the race early
scenarios.body: The favourite ties up in the final furlong after overexerting, leaving the door open for closers with tactical speed. No Return inherits the lead but gets swamped by late challengers with better finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy tactical affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get into a crawling pace battle and nobody wants to make the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with multiple horses hitting flat spots, creating an unpredictable finish where any horse can win. Diamont Katie and Valentine Catcher could benefit from the chaos despite their modest profiles.

watchPoints.text: Yorkshire Glory breaking from the pack in the final 2f - if he kicks clear with 200 yards to go, nothing will catch him
Azure Zain hanging left under pressure as he did on his return at Southwell, which could compromise his finishing effort
The pace through the first 3f - if Yorkshire Glory goes too fast early, he becomes very beatable in the final furlong
Great and Newsreader getting clear runs in the straight as both need racing room to show their best
No Return's position turning for home - if he's still tracking Yorkshire Glory at the 2f pole, he's the main danger

races.paceDynamic: Royal Deeside will lead with only Achnamara, Charlie Darling, Home And Dry and Capone likely to race prominently in the early stages. With most runners preferring hold-up tactics (Different Drum, Ebendi, Lillistar, Lady Phoebe, Edwardtheninth, Lion City, Izakaya), the pace will be moderate and sustainable over this marathon trip. The lack of pace pressure means Royal Deeside can dictate fractions and kick clear, while the patient hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses turning for home. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Royal Deeside Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Deeside gets an uncontested lead and stays the trip
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner dictates fractions without pressure and has enough stamina reserves to resist late challenges. His recent hurdles form suggests fitness levels are sharp despite poor recent Flat showings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the early prominent runners can track Royal Deeside and outstay him
scenarios.body: Charlie Darling or Achnamara sits close to the pace and has more in reserve for the final climb at this staying trip. The patient tactics prove superior to leading throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Different Drum or Lillistar produces a sweeping late run as the early leaders tire dramatically. Their class and finishing kick proves decisive when others have emptied their tanks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Izakaya Back-to-Form
scenarios.trigger: If Izakaya reproduces his autumn winning form and gets a strong ride
scenarios.body: The dual winner from last year gets a perfect tactical ride from Egan and his stamina proves superior. His previous course success at similar distances gives him the edge in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Royal Deeside could get an uncontested lead and prove very hard to peg back if his hurdles fitness translates
Different Drum's hurdles win 17 days ago suggests he's in form, watch for his late run if pace collapses
Achnamara represents Philip Kirby who has won two of the last six runnings of this race
Lillistar showed solid AW form recently and could be overlooked at a price with her hold-up style
Several runners returning from long breaks including Ebendi (175 days) and Home And Dry (180 days) make fitness questionable

races.name: Constant Security Serving Yorkshire Racecourses Handicap

runners_data.name: Fuji Mountain
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Zak Wheatley's 3-pound claim valuable, though trainer struggling at 0/15 in last fortnight

runners_data.name: Sergeant Mayer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning without cheekpieces, solid course form but poor recent trainer record of 0/23
runners_data.comment: Without cheekpieces when C&D 11th latest; can take a step forward in refitted headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Off six months and went without his usual cheekpieces when 11th over C&D two weeks ago; he scored twice at Ripon (5f) last May so no surprise to see him take a step forward here in refitted headgear.

runners_data.name: Speeding Bullet
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up horse with excellent last run in September, 228 days off but good course record
runners_data.comment: Good Haydock second in September; course winner could have more to offer in 2026; player
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark for his current yard over 6f here last June and signed off with an excellent runner-up at Haydock (5f) in September; that form worked out well and he could have more to offer in 2026 so he's a player.

runners_data.name: Midnight Lir
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but without a win since 2023, needs significant improvement after 201-day absence
runners_data.comment: Without a victory since 2023 and he beat one at Newcastle when last seen out in October
runners_data.spotlight: Without a victory since 2023 and he beat one in 5f Newcastle handicap when last seen out in October; lots more is needed after six months off.

runners_data.name: Komorkis
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making encouraging start for new connections, headgear applied for first time
runners_data.comment: Encouraging start for new yard with Nottingham fourth 13 days ago; in the mix with hood on
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 5f winner for Richard Fahey in 2025; changed hands for 1,400 guineas after but she made an encouraging start for her new yard with fourth of seven in 5f Nottingham handicap 13 days ago; in the mix with hood added.

runners_data.name: Military Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner 3lb below last winning mark, 175 days off but solid course and distance record
runners_data.comment: Scored on Catterick return last season and mainly performed with credit after; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Scored on her reappearance at Catterick (5f) last season and mainly performed with credit after; she's now 3lb below that winning mark so needs considering.

runners_data.name: Betweenthesticks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with recent Wolverhampton win, only 2lb penalty to carry
runners_data.comment: Returned with Wolverhampton win; this C&D scorer is not taken lightly in his current mood
runners_data.spotlight: Returned from six months off with success in 5f Wolverhampton handicap 17 days ago; up 2lb but this C&D scorer is not taken lightly in his current mood.

runners_data.name: Dark Kestrel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who excels on AW but unproven on turf, race fit from recent runs
runners_data.comment: A dual 5f winner at Newcastle this year but yet to show his best form on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Kept busy on the AW this winter and already a dual 5f winner at Newcastle; not out of things if translating that form but he's yet to show his best form on turf.

runners_data.name: Tanjen
runners_data.note: Front runner who needs to overcome 212-day layoff, David Allan booking suggests stable confidence
runners_data.comment: Not seen out after poor 12th at Southwell in September; needs to hit the ground running
runners_data.spotlight: Scored twice on AW in 2025 last autumn but he wasn't seen out after a poor 12th at Southwell (5f) in September; needs to hit the ground running after seven months off.

runners_data.name: Hidden Verse
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent pipe-opener at Bath, two-time 5f winner who should strip fitter
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced after eight months off when sixth at Bath recently; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: A two-time 5f scorer in 2025; not disgraced after eight months off when sixth of 13 in 5f Bath handicap 16 days ago; one to consider with that run under his belt.

runners_data.name: Filly's Last Lady
runners_data.note: Prominent runner struggling for new connections, 5-month break before disappointing Catterick run
runners_data.comment: Yet to fire in two runs for this yard; Catterick seventh latest; needs to build on that
runners_data.spotlight: A two-time 5f/6f winner in 2025 for Keiran Burke but yet to fire in two runs for her current yard and had been off five months before seventh of 12 in 6f Catterick handicap 13 days ago; needs to build on that.

races.paceDynamic: Tanjen represents the sole confirmed front runner and will likely get an uncontested lead with Fuji Mountain, Betweenthesticks and Filly's Last Lady settling in behind. The majority of the field are hold-up horses including Speeding Bullet, Sergeant Mayer, Military Girl, Komorkis, Midnight Lir, Dark Kestrel and Hidden Verse who will track the early pace. With minimal early pressure on Tanjen, this creates a sustainable gallop that will likely quicken late over this sharp 5f trip. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and those with proven tactical speed to position close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Tanjen gets soft fractions and stays strong late
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the front runner to dictate terms and kick clear when the field comes to challenge. Tanjen's 7-month break becomes less relevant with David Allan able to control the tempo from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian early doors
scenarios.body: Fuji Mountain and Betweenthesticks can use their prominent style to sit close and outfinish a tiring leader in the final furlong. Their recent form and ability to race handily gives them the edge over deeper held horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sweeps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway
scenarios.body: Military Girl and Speeding Bullet can use their hold-up style to come from off the pace as the early leaders tire. Both have shown strong finishing kicks and benefit from a truly run race that sets up their closing style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire returning from breaks
scenarios.body: Dark Kestrel or Sergeant Mayer could benefit from race fitness having run more recently. Their AW form and lower expectations could see them outrun their odds if the market leaders disappoint after layoffs.

watchPoints.text: Tanjen sets the fractions from the front - if he goes too fast early he'll be vulnerable late to finishers
Betweenthesticks carries a penalty after recent win but his prominent style suits if pace becomes pedestrian
Speeding Bullet returning after 228 days but his last run form has worked out well and he likes the course
Military Girl drops to 3lb below her last winning mark and could outrun odds with hold-up style
Dark Kestrel needs to prove AW form translates to turf having never shown his best on grass
